items.author: tran.q
items.title: Lab notebook: BRT-7 stability run 1
items.body:
Notebook entry, BRT-7 lyophilization, run 1.
Formulation: 5% trehalose, 20 mM Tris pH 8.0.
Cycle: freeze -45 C, primary drying -25 C shelf, secondary 25 C.
Result after 8 weeks at 37 C: 72% residual activity (n=3: 70%, 72%, 74%).
Conclusion: trehalose alone is insufficient. Next: test higher-Tg matrix.

items.author: aisha.b
items.title: Lab notebook: BRT-7 stability run 2
items.body:
Notebook entry, run 2.
Formulation: 4% sucrose, 3% dextran 40.
Result after 8 weeks at 37 C: 81% residual activity. Residual moisture 2.8%.
Observation: partial cake collapse in 2 of 6 vials. Suspect cycle runs above collapse temperature.

items.author: aisha.b
items.title: Lab notebook: BRT-7 stability run 3
items.body:
Notebook entry, run 3.
Formulation: 5% trehalose, 50 mM arginine, 2% pullulan.
Cycle: primary drying at -32 C shelf after collapse measured at -29 C.
Residual moisture 1.1%.
Result after 8 weeks at 37 C: 94% residual activity (n=3: 92%, 94%, 95%).
Open question: does the 37 C model predict 25 C real-time behaviour for this matrix?
